Name: Victy's Sandy Portrait Redone
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
[RE-EDITED] Made her ponytail less vibrant to match the front a little better.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/YwYMrI7m.jpg[/img]

I randomly found a better Sandy portrait on Google images which pointed me in the direction of the ChuckleFish forums created by a user by the name of [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/victy.634904/]Victy[/url]. I didn't like the original side-view of Sandy but I also didn't completely admire her with her hair down completely so I found some middle ground in an edit combining the two. Credit goes to [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/victy.634904/]Victy[/url] for the original post, which can be found [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/prettier-villager-portraits.112314/#post-2882120]here[/url] entitled "Prettier villager portraits!" containing more interesting character portraits as well (most notably Harvey, Jodi, Caroline & Emily). Hoping to see Pierre added to this thread!
